segments.ne9:1.3: Byañjanena suttassa neruttañca adhippāyo ca nidānañca pubbāparasandhi ca gavesitabbo.
segments.ne9:1.4: Tattha katamaṃ neruttaṃ, yā niruttipadasaṃhitā, yaṃ dhammānaṃ nāmaso ñāṇaṃ.
segments.ne9:1.5: Yadā hi bhikkhu atthassa ca nāmaṃ jānāti, dhammassa ca nāmaṃ jānāti, tathā tathā naṃ abhiniropeti.
segments.ne9:1.6: Ayañca vuccati atthakusalo dhammakusalo byañjanakusalo niruttikusalo pubbāparakusalo desanākusalo atītādhivacanakusalo anāgatādhivacanakusalo paccuppannādhivacanakusalo itthādhivacanakusalo purisādhivacanakusalo napuṃsakādhivacanakusalo ekādhivacanakusalo anekādhivacanakusalo, evaṃ sabbāni kātabbāni janapadaniruttāni sabbā ca janapadaniruttiyo.
segments.ne9:3.1: “Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, chattaṃ mahantaṃ yatha vassakāle [viya vassakāle jā.1.10.103];
segments.ne9:3.3: Esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī”ti.
segments.ne9:4.2: Ye apāyehi parimuccitukāmā bhavissanti, te dhammacārino bhavissantīti ayaṃ ettha bhagavato adhippāyo.
segments.ne9:5.1: “Coro yathā sandhimukhe gahīto, sakammunā haññati [haññate (sī.)] bajjhate ca;
segments.ne9:5.3: Evaṃ ayaṃ pecca pajā parattha, sakammunā haññati [haññate (sī.)] bajjhate cā”ti.
segments.ne9:6.2: Sañcetanikānaṃ katānaṃ kammānaṃ upacitānaṃ dukkhavedanīyānaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ asātaṃ vipākaṃ paccanubhavissatīti ayaṃ ettha bhagavato adhippāyo.
segments.ne9:7.1: “Sukhakāmāni [passa dha. pa.131-132] bhūtāni, yo daṇḍena vihiṃsati;
segments.ne9:7.3: Attano sukhamesāno, pecca so na labhate sukhan”ti.
segments.ne9:8.2: Ye sukhena atthikā bhavissanti, te pāpakammaṃ [pāpakaṃ kammaṃ (ka.)] na karissantīti ayaṃ ettha bhagavato adhippāyo.
segments.ne9:9.1: “Middhī [passa dha. pa.325] yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī;
segments.ne9:10.2: Ye jarāmaraṇena aṭṭiyitukāmā bhavissanti, te bhavissanti bhojane mattaññuno indriyesu guttadvārā pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogamanuyuttā vipassakā kusalesu dhammesu sagāravā ca sabrahmacārīsu theresu navesu majjhimesūti ayaṃ ettha bhagavato adhippāyo.
segments.ne9:11.1: “Appamādo amatapadaṃ [amataṃ padaṃ (ka.) passa dha. pa.21], pamādo maccuno padaṃ;
segments.ne9:11.3: Appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā”ti.
segments.ne9:12.2: Ye amatapariyesanaṃ pariyesitukāmā bhavissanti, te appamattā viharissantīti ayaṃ ettha bhagavato adhippāyo.
segments.ne9:13.2: Yathā so dhaniyo gopālako bhagavantaṃ āha –
segments.ne9:14.1: “Nandati puttehi puttimā, gomā [gomiko (sī.), gopiko (ka.) su. ni.33; saṃ. ni.1.144 passitabbaṃ] gohi tatheva nandati;
segments.ne9:14.3: Upadhī hi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhī”ti.
segments.ne9:16.1: “Socati puttehi puttimā, gopiko [gomiko (sī.)] gohi tatheva socati;
segments.ne9:16.3: Upadhī hi narassa socanā, na hi so socati yo nirūpadhī”ti.
segments.ne9:17.1: Iminā vatthunā iminā nidānena evaṃ ñāyati “idha bhagavā bāhiraṃ pariggahaṃ upadhi āhā”ti.
segments.ne9:17.2: Yathā ca māro pāpimā gijjhakūṭā pabbatā puthusilaṃ pātesi, bhagavā āha –
segments.ne9:18.1: “Sacepi kevalaṃ sabbaṃ, gijjhakūṭaṃ calessasi [caleyyāsi (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.147];
segments.ne9:19.1: Nabhaṃ phaleyyappathavī caleyya, sabbeva pāṇā uda santaseyyuṃ;
segments.ne9:19.3: Sallampi ce urasi kampayeyyuṃ [pakampayeyyuṃ (sī.), kappayeyyuṃ (ka.)], upadhīsu tāṇaṃ na karonti buddhā”ti.
segments.ne9:20.1: Iminā vatthunā iminā nidānena evaṃ ñāyati “idha bhagavā kāyaṃ upadhiṃ āhā”ti.
segments.ne9:21.1: “Na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañca [dārujaṃ babbajañca (sī.) passa dha. pa.345];
segments.ne9:21.3: Sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā”ti.
segments.ne9:22.1: Iminā vatthunā iminā nidānena evaṃ ñāyati “idha bhagavā bāhiresu vatthūsu taṇhaṃ āhā”ti.
segments.ne9:23.1: “Etaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā, ohārinaṃ sithilaṃ duppamuñcaṃ;
segments.ne9:23.3: Etampi chetvāna paribbajanti, anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāyā”ti.
segments.ne9:24.1: Iminā vatthunā iminā nidānena evaṃ ñāyati “idha bhagavā bāhiravatthukāya taṇhāya pahānaṃ āhā”ti.
segments.ne9:26.1: Iminā vatthunā iminā nidānena evaṃ ñāyati “idha bhagavā ajjhattikavatthukāya taṇhāya pahānaṃ āhā”ti.
segments.ne9:27.1: “Ucchinda [passa dha. pa.285] sinehamattano, kumudaṃ sāradikaṃva pāṇinā;
segments.ne9:28.1: Iminā vatthunā iminā nidānena evaṃ ñāyati “idha bhagavā ajjhattikavatthukāya taṇhāya pahānaṃ āhā”ti.
segments.ne9:30.3: Pamattabandhanā [pamattabandhunā udā.64] baddhā [bandhā (ka.) passa udā.64], macchāva kumināmukhe;
segments.ne9:32.1: “Ratto atthaṃ na jānāti, ratto dhammaṃ na passati;
segments.ne9:32.3: Andhantamaṃ tadā hoti, yaṃ rāgo sahate naran”ti.
segments.ne9:33.1: Iti andhatāya ca sañchannatāya ca sāyeva taṇhā abhilapitā.
segments.ne9:33.3: Yañcāha ratto atthaṃ na jānāti, ratto dhammaṃ na passatīti, imehi padehi pariyuṭṭhānehi sāyeva taṇhā abhilapitā.
segments.ne9:33.4: Yaṃ andhakāraṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo, yā ca taṇhā ponobhavikā, yañcāha kāmāti ime kilesakāmā.
segments.ne9:33.5: Yañcāha jālasañchannāti tesaṃ yeva kāmānaṃ payogena pariyuṭṭhānaṃ dasseti, tasmā kilesavasena ca pariyuṭṭhānavasena ca taṇhābandhanaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.ne9:33.6: Ye edisikā, te jarāmaraṇaṃ anventi, ayaṃ bhagavatā yathānikkhittagāthābalena dassitā jarāmaraṇamanventīti.
segments.ne9:34.1: “Yassa papañcā ṭhitī ca natthi, sandānaṃ palighañca [paḷighañca (sī.) passa udā.67] vītivatto;
segments.ne9:34.3: Taṃ nittaṇhaṃ muniṃ carantaṃ, na vijānāti sadevakopi loko”ti.
segments.ne9:35.1: Papañcā nāma taṇhādiṭṭhimānā, tadabhisaṅkhatā ca saṅkhārā.
segments.ne9:35.3: Sandānaṃ nāma taṇhāya pariyuṭṭhānaṃ, yāni chattiṃsataṇhāya jāliniyā vicaritāni.
segments.ne9:35.5: Ye ca papañcā saṅkhārā yā ca ṭhiti yaṃ sandānañca yaṃ palighañca yo etaṃ sabbaṃ samatikkanto, ayaṃ vuccati nittaṇho iti.
segments.ne9:36.1: Tattha pariyuṭṭhānasaṅkhārā diṭṭhadhammavedanīyā vā upapajjavedanīyā vā aparāpariyavedanīyā vā, evaṃ taṇhā tividhaṃ phalaṃ deti diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
segments.ne9:36.2: Evaṃ bhagavā āha “yaṃ lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ karoti kāyena vā vācāya vā manasā vā, tassa vipākaṃ anubhoti diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye”ti.
segments.ne9:36.5: Tattha pariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ vā kammaṃ upapajjavedanīyaṃ vā kammaṃ aparāpariyāyavedanīyaṃ [aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ (sī.)] vā kammaṃ, evaṃ kammaṃ tidhā vipaccati diṭṭhe vā dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
segments.ne9:37.1: “Yañce bālo idha pāṇātipātī hoti … pe … micchādiṭṭhi hoti, tassa diṭṭhe vā dhamme vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye”ti.
segments.ne9:37.4: Tattha pariyuṭṭhānaṃ paṭisaṅkhānabalena pahātabbaṃ, saṅkhārā dassanabalena, chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni bhāvanābalena pahātabbānīti evaṃ taṇhāpi tidhā pahīyati.
segments.ne9:38.2: Yañcāha bhagavā “papañceti atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ ārabbhā”ti.
segments.ne9:38.4: “atīte, rādha, rūpe anapekkho hohi, anāgataṃ rūpaṃ mā abhinandi, paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭinissaggāya paṭipajjā”ti.
segments.ne9:38.6: Yo cāpi papañco ye ca saṅkhārā yā ca atītānāgatapaccuppannassa abhinandanā, idaṃ ekatthaṃ.
segments.ne9:38.7: Api ca aññamaññehi padehi aññamaññehi akkharehi aññamaññehi byañjanehi aparimāṇā dhammadesanā vuttā bhagavatā.
segments.ne9:38.8: Evaṃ suttena suttaṃ saṃsandayitvā pubbāparena saddhiṃ yojayitvā suttaṃ niddiṭṭhaṃ bhavati.
segments.ne9:39.1: So cāyaṃ [sa cāyaṃ (sī.)] pubbāparo sandhi catubbidho atthasandhi byañjanasandhi desanāsandhi niddesasandhīti.
segments.ne9:40.1: Tattha atthasandhi chappadāni saṅkāsanā pakāsanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammatā paññattīti.
segments.ne9:41.1: Byañjanasandhi chappadāni akkharaṃ padaṃ byañjanaṃ ākāro nirutti niddesoti.
segments.ne9:42.1: Desanāsandhi na ca pathaviṃ nissāya jhāyati jhāyī jhāyati ca.
segments.ne9:42.2: Na ca āpaṃ nissāya jhāyati jhāyī jhāyati ca, na ca tejaṃ nissāya jhāyati jhāyī jhāyati ca, na ca vāyuṃ nissāya jhāyati jhāyī jhāyati ca. Na ca ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ nissāya … pe … na ca viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ nissāya … pe … na ca ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nissāya … pe … na ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nissāya … pe … na ca imaṃ lokaṃ nissāya … pe … na ca paralokaṃ nissāya jhāyati jhāyī jhāyati ca.
segments.ne9:42.3: Yamidaṃ ubhayamantarena diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ vitakkitaṃ vicāritaṃ manasānucintitaṃ, tampi nissāya na jhāyati jhāyī jhāyati ca.
segments.ne9:42.4: Ayaṃ sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anissitena cittena na ñāyati jhāyanto.
segments.ne9:43.1: Yathā māro pāpimā godhikassa kulaputtassa [passa saṃ. ni.1.159] viññāṇaṃ samanvesanto na jānāti na passati.
segments.ne9:43.2: So hi papañcātīto taṇhāpahānena diṭṭhinissayopissa natthi.
segments.ne9:43.3: Yathā ca godhikassa, evaṃ vakkalissa sadevakena lokena samārakena sabrahmakena sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anissitacittā na ñāyanti jhāyamānā.
segments.ne9:44.2: Nissitacittā akusalapakkhena niddisitabbā, anissitacittā kusalapakkhena niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.3: Nissitacittā kilesena niddisitabbā, anissitacittā vodānena niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.4: Nissitacittā saṃsārappavattiyā niddisitabbā, anissitacittā saṃsāranivattiyā niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.5: Nissitacittā taṇhāya ca avijjāya ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā samathena ca vipassanāya ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.6: Nissitacittā ahirikena ca anottappena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā hiriyā ca ottappena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.7: Nissitacittā asatiyā ca asampajaññena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā satiyā ca sampajaññena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.8: Nissitacittā ayoniyā ca ayonisomanasikārena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā yoniyā ca yonisomanasikārena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.9: Nissitacittā kosajjena ca dovacassena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā vīriyārambhena ca sovacassena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.10: Nissitacittā assaddhiyena ca pamādena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā saddhāya ca appamādena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.11: Nissitacittā asaddhammassavanena ca asaṃvaraṇena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā saddhammassavanena ca saṃvarena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.12: Nissitacittā abhijjhāya ca byāpādena ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā anabhijjhāya ca abyāpādena ca niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.13: Nissitacittā nīvaraṇehi ca saṃyojaniyehi ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā rāgavirāgāya ca cetovimuttiyā avijjāvirāgāya ca paññāvimuttiyā niddisitabbā.
segments.ne9:44.14: Nissitacittā ucchedadiṭṭhiyā ca sassatadiṭṭhiyā ca niddisitabbā, anissitacittā saupādisesāya ca anupādisesāya ca nibbānadhātuyā niddisitabbā.

lines: Tattha byañjanena suttassa neruttañca adhippāyo ca nidānañca pubbāparasandhi ca gavesitabboti saṅkhepena tāva catubyūhaṃ dasseti.
“Byañjanenā”ti iminā hārānaṃ suttassa byañjanavicayabhāvato byañjanamukheneva ete catubyūhahārapadatthā niddhāretabbāti dasseti.
Padasaṃhitāti padesu saṃhitā yuttā, liṅgavacanakālasādhanapurisādivisesayogena yo yo attho yathā yathā vattabbo, tathā tathā pavattasabhāvaniruttīti attho.
Tathā hi vuttaṃ “yaṃ dhammānaṃ nāmaso ñāṇan”ti.
Tattha yanti hetuatthe nipāto, yāya kāraṇabhūtāyāti attho.
Nāmasoti pathavī phasso khandhā dhātu tisso phussoti evamādināmavisesena ñāṇaṃ pavattati, ayaṃ sabhāvanirutti nāma.
Pathavīti hi evamādikaṃ saddaṃ gahetvā tato paraṃ saṅketadvārena tadatthapaṭipatti taṃtaṃaniyatanāmapaññattiggahaṇavaseneva hotīti.
So panassa atthe pavattinimittabhūtāya paññattiyā gahitāya eva hotīti sā pana paññatti niruttisaṅkhātapadena saṃhitā padatthaṃ bodhetīti padasaṃhitāti vuttā.
“Yadā hi bhikkhū”tiādinā “dhammānaṃ nāmaso ñāṇan”ti padassa atthaṃ vivarati.
Nāmaṃ jānātīti nāmapaññattivasena ayaṃ nāmāti nāmaṃ jānāti.
Tathā tathā naṃ abhiniropetīti yo yo attho dhammo ca yathā yathā ca voharitabbo, tathā tathā naṃ nāmaṃ vohāraṃ abhiniropeti desetīti attho.
Ettāvatā ca ayaṃ bhikkhu atthakusalo yāva anekādhivacanakusaloti vuccatīti sambandhitabbaṃ.
Evaṃ sabbāni kātabbāni, janapadaniruttānīti yattakāni sattavohārapadāni, tāni sabbāni yathāsambhavaṃ sutte nibbacanavasena kātabbāni vattabbānīti attho.
Sabbā ca janapadaniruttiyoti sabbā ca lokasamaññāyo yathārahaṃ kātabbā.
Pubbāparenāti pubbena vā aparena vā desanantarenāti adhippāyo.
Imehi padehi pariyuṭṭhānehīti imehi yathāvuttehi gāthāpadehi taṇhāpariyuṭṭhānadīpakehi.
Sāyeva taṇhāti yā purimagāthāya vuttā, sāyeva taṇhā.
Tasmāti yattha sayaṃ uppannā, taṃ santānaṃ nissarituṃ adentī nānārammaṇehi palobhayamānā kilesehi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
Tasmā kilesavasena ca pariyuṭṭhānavasena ca taṇhābandhanaṃ vuttā.
Attahitaparahitānaṃ idhalokaparalokānañca munanato munīti evaṃ gāthāya padattho veditabbo.
Tattha yassete papañcādayo abbhatthaṃ gatā, tassa taṇhāya lesopi na bhavati.
“yo etaṃ sabbaṃ samatikkanto, ayaṃ vuccati nittaṇho”ti.
Te pana yasmā sattasu javanacetanāsu paṭhamacetanā sati paccayasamavāye imasmiṃyeva attabhāve phalaṃ deti.
Ubhinnaṃ vemajjhacetanā yattha katthaci phalaṃ deti, tasmā vipaccanokāsavasena vibhajitvā dassetuṃ “diṭṭhadhammavedanīyā vā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Yasmā pana taṃtaṃcetanāsampayuttā taṇhāpi cetanā viya diṭṭhadhammavedanīyādivasena tidhā hoti, tasmā vuttaṃ –

Pubbāparena yujjatīti yaṃ pubbaṃ purimaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyatādivacanaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ iminā aparena kammassa diṭṭhadhammavedanīyatādivacanena yujjati gaṅgodakaṃ viya yamunodakena saṃsandati sametīti attho.
Saṅkhārā dassanabalenāti catūsu diṭṭhigatasampayuttesu vicikicchāsampayutte cāti pañcasu cittuppādesu saṅkhārā paṭhamamaggapaññābalena.
Chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni bhāvanābalenāti paṭhamamaggena pahīnāvasesavasena vuttaṃ, na sabbesaṃ vasena.
Yadipi atthato ekaṃ, desanāya pana viseso vijjatīti dassetuṃ “api cā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Pubbāparena saddhiṃ yojayitvāti pubbena vā aparena vā suttena saddhiṃ atthato sambandhaṃ yojetvā.
Vuttamevatthaṃ pākaṭaṃ karoti tena suttassa attho niddiṭṭho hoti vitthārito suttantaradassanena.
Na kevalaṃ suttantarasaṃsandanameva pubbāparasandhi, atha kho aññopi atthīti dassetuṃ “so cāyan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
So pana yasmā saṅkāsanādīnaṃ channaṃ atthapadānaṃyeva hoti, sabbassāpi padatthassa tadavarodhato.
Sambandho ca nāma na koci attho.
Yasmā pana sabbampi nāmādipadaṃ chahi byañjanapadehi asaṅgahitaṃ nāma natthi, tasmā “byañjanasandhi chappadānī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Na ca pathaviṃ nissāyāti pathaviṃ visayasaṅkhātaṃ nissayaṃ katvā, pathaviṃ ālambitvāti attho.
So hi sabbasaṅkhāranissaṭaṃ nibbānaṃ ālambitvā samāpajjanavasena jhāyati, na pathaviṃ nissāya jhāyatīti vutto.
Ettha ca catūhi mahābhūtehi rūpappaṭibaddhavuttitāya sabbo kāmabhavo rūpabhavo ca gahitā.
Arūpabhavo pana sarūpeneva gahitoti sabbaṃ lokaṃ pariyādiyitvā puna aññenapi pariyāyena taṃ dassetuṃ “na ca imaṃ lokan”tiādimāha.
Sabbo hi loko idhaloko paraloko cāti dveva koṭṭhāsā honti.
Yasmā pana “idhaloko”ti visesato diṭṭhadhammabhūto sattasantāno vuccati.
Ye pana “ubhayamantarenā”ti vacanaṃ gahetvā antarābhavaṃ icchanti, tesaṃ taṃ micchā.

Ayaṃ sadevake … pe … anissitena cittena na ñāyati jhāyantoti ayaṃ khīṇāsavo phalasamāpattijhānena jhāyanto pubbeva taṇhādiṭṭhinissayānaṃ suṭṭhu pahīnattā sadevake loke … pe … manussāya yattha katthacipi anissitena cittena jhāyati nāma.
Tato eva loke kenacipi na ñāyati “ayaṃ idaṃ nāma nissāya jhāyatī”ti.
Yassa te nābhijānāma, kiṃ tvaṃ nissāya jhāyasī”ti.(netti.104);
Idāni khīṇāsavacittassa katthacipi anissitabhāvaṃ godhikasuttena (saṃ. ni.1.159) vakkalisuttena (saṃ. ni.3.87) ca vibhāvetuṃ “yathā māro”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Anissitacittā na ñāyanti jhāyamānāti na kevalaṃ anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā khīṇāsavassa cittagatiṃ mārādayo na jānanti, api ca kho saupādisesāyapi nibbānadhātuyā tassa taṃ na jānantīti attho.
Ayaṃ desanāsandhīti godhikasuttavakkalisuttānaṃ viya suttantānaṃ aññamaññaatthasaṃsandanā desanāsandhi nāma.
Niddesasandhīti niddesassa sandhi niddesasandhi, niddesena vā sandhi niddesasandhi.
Purimena suttassa niddesena tasseva pacchimassa niddesassa, pacchimena vā purimassa sambandhananti attho.
Taṃ dassetuṃ yasmā bhagavā yebhuyyena paṭhamaṃ vaṭṭaṃ dassetvā pacchā vivaṭṭaṃ dasseti, tasmā “nissitacittā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha nissitaṃ cittaṃ etesanti nissitacittā, puggalā, niddisitabbā puggalādhiṭṭhānāya desanāyāti adhippāyo.
Dhammādhiṭṭhānāya pana nissitaṃ cittaṃ etthāti nissitacittā, nissitacittavanto taṇhādiṭṭhinissayavasena pavattā suttapadesā.

lines: Apare pana “idhāti kāmabhavo, huranti arūpabhavo, ubhayamantarenāti rūpabhavo vutto”ti vadanti,“idhāti paccayadhammā, huranti paccayuppannadhammā, ubhayamantarenāti paṇṇattidhammā vuttā”ti ca vadanti, taṃ sabbaaṭṭhakathāsu natthi, tasmā vuttanayeneva attho veditabbo.
Avasiṭṭhaṃ rūpanti āpodhātuākāsadhātūhi saddhiṃ lakkhaṇarūpāni, ojañca sandhāyāha anindriyabaddharūpassa adhippetattā.
Tassa khīṇāsavassa taṃ nibbānārammaṇaṃ cittaṃ na jānanti na ñāyanti “jhāyamānā”ti vuttattā.
